underlying_goal: Fix dictionary data loading failure caused by browser API calls hitting localhost:8080 (user's PC) instead of the backend service, by implementing a proxy solution in Next.js
friction_detail: Initial rewrites-based proxy approach didn't work in Next.js standalone mode, requiring a pivot to API Route Handler approach after user reported the issue persisted.
brief_summary: User asked to implement a Next.js rewrites proxy plan to fix API calls failing in browser, but the initial approach didn't work in standalone mode; Claude diagnosed the issue and proposed an API Route Handler solution but session ended before full re-implementation.
